source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 by exhaustive search with no input array and no random numbers, run by programs/recipe_item123.sh, which wrote programs/RECIPE_build.log. The group Z3 x Z3 permutes the 18 rows in six orbits of 3 rows, two orbits for each of three subgroups of order 3 (programs/mkgrp.py z3z3 a,a,b,b,c,c 0). The program programs/orbq7.c lists every ternary column whose 9 images under the group are pairwise qualitatively independent (90,720 column orbits), joins two orbits when all their columns are pairwise qualitatively independent, and lists every set of 4 mutually joined orbits up to the normaliser of the group (27 sets, each an 18 x 36 covering array, and no set of 5 exists). For each set it lists every further column that is qualitatively independent of all 36 columns and finds the largest mutually independent set of them. Two of the sets take 16 further columns, 9 take 4 and 16 take 1. The array is the first set that takes 16 (command orbq7 z_18_aabbcc_f0.txt 4 20 w18). Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
construction: Array invariant under Z3 x Z3 acting on the 18 rows in six orbits of 3: four column orbits of length 9 and sixteen further columns, found by exhaustive search

source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-10 in two steps, both run by programs/recipe_item123.sh, which wrote programs/RECIPE_build.log. Step 1, profile product (method of Colbourn and Torres-Jimenez 2013, Thm 4.2 / Cor 4.5, programs/pprod.py) of the CA(18; 2, 52, 3) of this submission (rows 0 and 1, 13 agreements) with the orthogonal array OA(9, 4, 3) with rows (i, j, i+j, i+2j) mod 3 (rows 0 and 1, 1 agreement), giving CA(24; 2, 195, 3). Step 2, column extension at 24 rows with programs/ext2t.c, one column at a time, each new column the best of 200 random columns, then simulated annealing with exact pair counts in which only the new column may change (temperature 0.7, seed 13), and a stuck column redrawn after 200000 moves. The array saved after the 14th added column has 209 columns (move 19,751,928 of the run). Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
